more-in-there-than-you-typed.title: More in there than you typed
more-in-there-than-you-typed.script: So, how's your brain doing? Anything fried yet? I'm not done yet, so try to keep up. You have seen the window fill with your messages. But your messages are only a part of it, so the next question is what else goes in without you noticing.
